scope: Next twenty still-unreviewed anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins originals in cohort order
hash_verification: Each selected path matched exactly one bundle file; original SHA256 matched both cohort and bundle, and Git blob SHA1 matched the object name.
linked_reference_caveat: Linked references and connector documentation were not read. Missing adapters are prerequisite gaps, not permanent exclusions or observed failures. No source workflow was executed.

sources.workflow: Benchmark compensation, analyze employee band placement, or model equity; report percentile bands and recommendations.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A role and relevant level and location, uploaded compensation data, or equity assumptions; market data or user-provided context for benchmarks.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied datasets and equity assumptions support offline calculations and drafting. Current market benchmarks and HRIS-derived employee data require the relevant data source or service; confidentiality must be respected.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check calculations against supplied data, benchmark provenance and freshness, assumptions, and whether any recommendations exceed the evidence.

sources.workflow: Assess an initiative for potentially applicable requirements, risks, actions, and approvals, using privacy, agreement, request-handling, and monitoring checklists.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A description of the proposed action, geography, personal data and relevant organizational circumstances; current authoritative requirements and qualified legal review.
sources.offline_assessment: A preliminary checklist and an assessment grounded in supplied materials can be drafted offline. Current law, applicability, approval status and actual compliance need authoritative sources and qualified human verification.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A qualified reviewer must verify jurisdiction-specific current authorities, initiative facts, documented controls and actual approval records; treat unknowns as unknown.

sources.workflow: Organize control inventories, audit calendars, evidence and gap analyses into readiness outputs.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Applicable framework requirements, control ownership and effectiveness, audit dates, evidence locations and current-state information.
sources.offline_assessment: An inventory, checklist or gap analysis can be constructed from supplied records. Actual readiness and compliance cannot be established from a template alone.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare each claimed control and status with dated evidence, accountable owners, audit scope and applicable requirements.

sources.workflow: Audit scoped open opportunities for missing, stale or inconsistent fields and return an evidence-backed fix checklist; corrections are handed off.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A defined opportunity scope and either a CRM or uploaded pipeline export; relevant schema, dates and history for the checks performed.
sources.offline_assessment: The original explicitly supports auditing an uploaded export, with missing history and document checks disclosed. Live CRM schema, current records and applying changes require appropriate connections or a human.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Recompute flags from the export or read records, verify date anchoring and unavailable checks, and inspect any separately applied changes.

sources.workflow: Gather issue history, assess impact and severity, identify the escalation target, and prepare a brief with reproduction details and follow-up.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An issue description and available customer, troubleshooting, impact and timeline evidence; bug reproduction details when applicable.
sources.offline_assessment: A brief can be drafted from supplied evidence with unknowns marked. Current tickets, account context, real reproduction, posting and customer follow-up require the relevant systems or people.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify source records, impact and severity, actual reproduction evidence, recipient and any claimed communications or follow-up.

sources.workflow: Research a customer question across prioritized sources, synthesize attributed findings with confidence, identify gaps and recommend verification or knowledge capture.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A question or topic and accessible source material; customer-facing sensitive answers may need specialist review.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied source documents permit a bounded, attributed synthesis. Live internal history or web research requires actual access; missing sources limit confidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect cited sources and dates, corroboration, contradictions and confidence, and obtain specialist confirmation where needed.

sources.workflow: Discover warehouse schemas and interview analysts to bootstrap a company-specific data skill, or extend an existing skill with new domain references.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Warehouse type and schema access, analyst answers about entities, identifiers, metrics and filters; iteration also needs the existing skill.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied schema snapshots and analyst answers can support drafting and packaging, but cannot independently establish live warehouse state. The referenced templates were not read.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare generated files and sample queries with schema and analyst-approved definitions, check dialect and navigation, and inspect the resulting package.

sources.workflow: Choose charts for data relationships and create static or interactive visualizations using Python patterns and accessibility principles.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A dataset and visualization objective; the appropriate Python libraries and rendering environment for actual chart generation.
sources.offline_assessment: Chart selection and design guidance are offline; charts can be produced offline with suitable data and an available runtime. Interactive behavior and accessibility need inspection rather than textual assertion.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check chart values against the dataset, labels and scales, rendered output, interactive behavior where applicable, and accessibility alternatives.

sources.workflow: Sweep a scoped pipeline for threshold-crossing changes and produce a prioritized digest with evidence and suggested actions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A scoped current book, a prior export for change detection when available, and organizational thresholds or labeled defaults.
sources.offline_assessment: The source supports a files-only sweep, including comparison with a prior export when available. Live messages, transcripts, current CRM data and scheduled recurrence require their respective runtime services.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Recompute triggered signals from dated inputs, verify skipped checks and scope, and check that missing records are not assumed won or lost.

sources.workflow: Critique a design's usability, hierarchy, consistency and accessibility, then prioritize actionable feedback.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A design image, design-tool artifact or detailed description, plus audience and design-stage context.
sources.offline_assessment: A critique of supplied material is possible offline. Pulling live design layers or user feedback requires access; interaction and accessibility claims need appropriate evidence beyond a static description.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect the design, measurements and relevant interaction states; validate contrast and usability claims against the actual artifact.

sources.workflow: Produce an engineering handoff covering layout, tokens, components, interaction states, responsive behavior and accessibility.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A design or description, including available measurements, states, behavior and technology context.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied specifications permit a draft offline, with missing measurements and behaviors left open. Exact live design properties, asset export and tracker changes need access to those systems.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the handoff against the source design and interactive states, check exact values and unresolved questions, and verify any tracker updates separately.

sources.workflow: Audit design-system consistency, document component variants and behavior, or propose a compatible new pattern.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A selected audit, documentation or extension target and the relevant component, token and existing-pattern information.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied component files and specifications support a bounded audit or documentation draft. Live design-tool inspection and knowledge-base publication require access.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect the actual system and component states, validate findings and proposed accessibility behavior, and confirm any publication separately.

sources.workflow: Collect activity over a daily, weekly or custom window, group related updates by topic and highlight actions, decisions and mentions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A time window and at least one connected source for the source's live workflow.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied activity snapshots can support a bounded analogous digest, but the original calls for at least one connected source and cannot establish current activity without it.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare each item and count with dated source records, verify the window and deduplication, and disclose unavailable sources.

sources.workflow: Draft channel-specific marketing content with brand voice, format, headline options and relevant SEO suggestions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Content type, topic, target audience, key messages and length; configured or supplied brand voice, or a neutral default.
sources.offline_assessment: A draft is feasible from supplied inputs offline. Factual claims, customer results, quotes and publication readiness need source evidence and human review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check the draft against the brief, channel constraints and brand guidance; substantiate claims and confirm placeholder quotations and metrics.

sources.workflow: Draft an offer package and letter with compensation, terms, benefits and hiring-manager notes.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Role, level, location, compensation, start date and manager, plus candidate and benefits details where needed.
sources.offline_assessment: A draft with supplied terms and explicit placeholders is possible offline. Actual headcount approval, current bands, benefits and applicant status require authoritative records; no approval should be inferred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Confirm candidate-specific terms, compensation calculations, benefits, approval evidence and appropriate human review before use.

sources.workflow: Research a prospect and prior contact, draft tailored outreach or a sequence, and create, send or enroll only in the relevant requested workflow.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Recipient and intent, organizational value proposition and voice, and reliable context for a personalized hook.
sources.offline_assessment: Stated context or a supplied book row supports paste-ready text. Live history, enrichment, creation of a mail draft, sending and sequence enrollment require their respective services and requested action.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check recipient selection, cited hook, prior-thread context, claims and actual service state for any draft, send or enrollment.

sources.workflow: Draft a customer-facing response suited to the issue, relationship and channel, with internal verification notes and escalation guidance.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Situation and customer context, relevant history, verified status and any authorized commitments.
sources.offline_assessment: A draft can be prepared from supplied evidence with unknowns flagged. Current account history, incident status, actual commitments and sending require authoritative records or people.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify each factual statement and commitment against records and authorized owners, and review tone and escalation before communication.

sources.workflow: Resolve a person's identity, enrich person and company information into a contact card, and offer follow-up actions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Identifying information and access to the named enrichment service; the source instructs a credit warning before person enrichment and user selection for ambiguous matches.
sources.offline_assessment: Only parsing supplied identifiers or formatting supplied records is possible offline. Actual enrichment, contact creation and sequence operations require the service and its runtime; private contact details must not be invented.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify the identity match, source fields and freshness, credit disclosure, and any requested action against actual service records.

sources.workflow: Profile a table or file, classify columns, assess quality, discover patterns and suggest follow-up analyses.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An accessible warehouse table or uploaded data file; schema-only input supports guidance rather than observed data profiling.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied file can be profiled with an appropriate offline runtime. Live warehouse metadata, actual table contents and cross-table relationships require access or representative supplied data.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Recalculate profiles and quality flags from the input, inspect sampling and types, and distinguish heuristic warnings from verified defects.

sources.workflow: Prepare a comparative income statement, metrics and material variance analysis, with balance-sheet and cash-flow reference formats.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Reporting period, current and comparison financial data, account groupings, known adjustments and relevant materiality thresholds.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied trial balances or spreadsheets support calculations and a draft offline. Current ledger completeness, explanations, applicable reporting requirements and filing readiness need authoritative evidence and qualified review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile source balances, classifications, adjustments, variance formulas and drivers; have a qualified financial professional review the output before reporting or filing.

source_reader: Delegated complete-original-body review; original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
